subject: a coastal succulent courtyard with low pale walls
art_direction: 海边低墙庭院种有雕塑般多肉，砂色砾地与蓝绿叶片形成简洁精美景观。
visible_description: 海边低墙庭院种有雕塑般多肉，砂色砾地与蓝绿叶片形成简洁精美景观。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Create a coastal succulent courtyard with low pale walls. Use three distinct succulent clusters with broad leaves, keeping the planting low. A narrow bench built into the wall and one shallow gravel path create structure. Let a thin sea band appear beyond the far wall beneath a clean upper sky. Render leaf edges and stone texture with restrained detail. Use matte architectural garden painting. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
